battle.name: 白江口之戰
battle.brief: 唐龍朔三年八月，唐朝與新羅聯軍在錦江下游白江口迎戰百濟復國軍與倭國援軍，兩日之內以橫陣與火攻全破敵軍，是中日第一次大規模交戰。卡面羅馬重步兵雖未曾在朝鮮出現，但其背後原理——戰力來自補充兵源與補給線而非重裝——正是此役關鍵：唐軍隨軍帶數百艘糧船，倭百濟卻是深入半島的孤軍。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 白江口之戰（663年）爆發在朝鮮半島南部，是唐、新羅、百濟復國勢力與倭國四方角力的結果。唐朝一方由高宗李治在長安策劃，前線交給降將劉仁軌與越州都督杜爽，水軍由劉仁軌在熊津都督府整頓，糧秣自越州、婺州、揚州等東南沿海裝船北上，戰船百艘、糧船數百艘由海路進入錦江下游；唐廷的目標是消滅百濟復國政權，恢復對半島的直接經略。新羅一方以金氏王權為核心，執事大等分掌兵糧，興法王金春秋在後方節制，前線由朴市田來札率領五千兵與百艘戰船配合作戰，目標是徹底吞併百濟故地並斷其外援。百濟復國一方以自日本返國的王子扶餘隆為王，和尚道琛與原百濟將扶餘福信輔政，根據地在周留城，靠倭國的船與兵維持。倭國方面由覽照皇后下詔、中大兄皇子主持，遣阿部比羅夫、上毛野君稚子、廬原君分批出兵，沿海路與百濟會合，是白江口外海一戰的主體。
countriesEn: The Battle of Baekgang (663) broke out in the southern part of the Korean peninsula as the outcome of a four-cornered struggle between the Tang, Silla, the Paekche restoration movement and Yamato Japan. On the Tang side Emperor Gaozong (Li Zhi) planned the campaign from Chang'an and handed the front to Liu Ren-gui, a surrendered Goguryeo general, together with Du Shuang, the governor of Yuezhou; the navy was reorganised by Liu at the commandery of Ungyeong, and the grain was loaded at the southeastern ports of Yuezhou, Wuzhou and Yangzhou and carried north by sea, a hundred warships and several hundred grain ships entering the lower reach of the Geum river. The Tang court's aim was to destroy the Paekche restoration regime and restore direct administration of the peninsula. On the Silla side the Kim monarchy was at the centre, the jipdaedale dividing the command of troops and of grain, with King Xingfa, Kim Chunchu, directing affairs in the rear; in the field Park Si-cheon-rae-chal led five thousand men and a hundred warships in cooperation with the Tang, with the aim of swallowing up the old Paekche lands entirely and cutting off its foreign help. The Paekche restoration side made Prince Buyeo Pung, who had returned from Japan, its king, with the monk Dochim and the former Paekche general Buyeo Boksin assisting him; its base was the fortress of Churyu, sustained by the ships and the soldiers of Japan. On the Japanese side Empress Kōgyoku issued the rescript and Prince Naka no Ōe directed the business, sending out in successive contingents Abe no Hirafu, Kamitsukeno no Kimi Wakako and Iohara no Kimi, who joined the Paekche by sea; these were the main body on the outer sea at the mouth of the Baek river.
people: 白江口之戰的關鍵人物分屬四營。唐方主角是劉仁軌，本為高句麗熊津都督府監察御史，他主張不等百濟援軍先到即主動出擊，663年率水軍自熊津入白江口，與杜爽所部合為唐軍主力，勝後受到朝廷重賞；高宗李治在長安遙控，戰前准其方略，並調發江南糧船以支持這場離岸數千里的遠征。新羅方面，前線主將朴市田來札領兵五千、戰船百艘，在白江口與唐軍會合，並掩護唐軍側翼；王都方面由執事大等與興法王金春秋主持，戰後新羅軍包圍周留城，迫扶餘隆出降。百濟方面，王扶餘隆自日本返國即位，與輔政將領扶餘福信（史籍亦作癸巳福信）互相猜忌，最終將其殺死，使百濟陣營在開戰前已不穩固，僧道琛則另行奔走。倭國方面，覽照皇后以詔書決斷出兵，中大兄皇子與中臣金連在承襲蘇我氏的政變後推動此役；阿部比羅夫率首批五千人、一百七十艘船抵百濟，上毛野君稚子與廬原君分別率後續兵力趕到戰場，名將惠能在接舷近戰中陣亡，使倭方失去一名老練的指揮者，而大伴弟麻呂則是使節與隨軍統帥。
peopleEn: The key figures of the battle fall into four camps. The central figure on the Tang side was Liu Ren-gui, originally a supervising censor of the Tang commandery of Ungyeong in former Goguryeo. He argued for taking the offensive before Paekche's reinforcements could arrive, and in 663 led his navy from Ungyeong into the mouth of the Baek river, joining the troops of Du Shuang to form the main body of the Tang force; after the victory he was rewarded by the court. Gaozong (Li Zhi) directed things from Chang'an, approved Liu's plan before the fighting, and dispatched grain ships from the southeast coast to support an expedition thousands of li from its base. On the Silla side the field commander was Park Si-cheon-rae-chal, who led five thousand men and a hundred warships, joined the Tang at the mouth of the river and covered the flank of the Tang line; in the capital the jipdaedale and King Xingfa, Kim Chunchu, took charge, and after the battle the Silla army surrounded Churyu and forced Buyeo Pung to surrender. On the Paekche side the king was Buyeo Pung, who had come back from Japan to take the throne; he distrusted his own assisting general, Buyeo Boksin (written in some sources as Gwisil Boksin), and had him put to death, so that the Paekche camp was already unstable before the battle opened, and the monk Dochim was moving about separately. On the Japanese side Empress Kōgyoku decided on the expedition by rescript, and Prince Naka no Ōe and Nakatomi no Kamatari drove it after the coup that overthrew the Soga. Abe no Hirafu brought the first contingent of five thousand men and a hundred and seventy ships to Paekche, and Kamitsukeno no Kimi Wakako and Iohara no Kimi arrived with the later contingents; the commander Echi no Takutsu was killed in the close fighting at the boarding of the ships, depriving the Japanese side of one of its most experienced leaders, while Yamato no Fuhito served as envoy and accompanied commander.
kits: 卡面兵器是羅馬重步兵（Legionary），這是一整套以分段鎧甲、重盾與標槍為核心的標準化重裝步兵編制，羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，而不是靠重裝。必須說明：這件裝備本身並未出現在663年的朝鮮半島，羅馬重步兵當時的對手是薩珊波斯與北方草原部族，不可能東渡參戰。但它所代表的原理，在白江口之戰幾乎一一對應。唐羅聯軍結橫陣於白江口，以大船居中、小船分列兩翼，弩、砲與標槍在接舷之前先做遠程消耗，正是標槍與弩砲的邏輯：不必與敵人比甲冑，先在接觸之前耗盡對方的投射物與體力；船身連成的橫陣與岸壁夾出的河道，則像羅馬方陣的正面與兩翼，盾線一旦接上，衝力便落在盾牌而不是人身上。另一個對應更精確：羅馬靠徵兵與糧道維持補充，唐軍此役隨軍攜帶數百艘糧船，等於把補給線當作戰力的一部分；反觀倭國與百濟的聯軍，是一支深入半島的遠征孤軍，糧秣全靠岸上接應，一旦戰敗，傷兵與殘兵無船可載，退路與後續兵源同時斷絕。裝備方面，唐軍與新羅配備弩、投石機、戈、鉤與唐刀，明光鎧與藤牌供登船與接舷兵使用；倭國船隊以長刀、弓與楯為主，並備大漁船作運輸，海上接舷與火攻是主要手段。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Roman legionary, a complete standardised heavy-infantry formation built around segmented armour, the heavy shield and the pilum, whose strength rested on the replenishment of manpower and on supply lines rather than on armour itself. It must be said that this equipment never appeared on the Korean peninsula in 663. The Roman legionary of that age faced the Sasanian empire and the peoples of the northern steppe, and could not have sailed east to take part. Yet the principle it embodies maps almost one to one onto the Battle of Baekgang. The Tang and Silla forces formed a line across the mouth of the river, large ships in the centre and small ships on the flanks, and used crossbows, stone-throwers and javelins for ranged harassment before boarding, which is the logic of the pilum and the bolt: there is no need to out-armour the enemy if his missiles and his stamina can be spent at a distance. The wall of hulls and the channel walled in by the banks correspond to the front and the flanks of a Roman square; once the shield line closes, the shock falls on the shield and not on the man. The second correspondence is even more exact. Rome maintained its strength through recruitment and the grain road, and the Tang army on this campaign carried several hundred grain ships with it, treating the supply line as part of the fighting power. The allied Japanese and Paekche force, by contrast, was an expeditionary army pushed deep into the peninsula, its food dependent on what the shore could give it, and once it was beaten the wounded and the survivors had no ships to carry them, so that the line of retreat and the flow of replacements were cut at the same moment. As to equipment, the Tang and Silla troops carried crossbows, stone-throwers, spears, boarding hooks and Tang swords, with bright armour and rattan shields for the men who scaled and boarded; the Japanese fleet relied on long swords, bows and shields, and kept large fishing craft for transport, and the main instruments of the fighting at sea were boarding and fire.
tactics: 白江口之戰的成敗由河道地形與陣線紀律決定。白江是錦江下游的一段，水道狹窄，兩岸多泥灘與淺堤，大船難以展開與超越，小船卻能穿梭騷擾。唐軍主將劉仁軌以船與船首尾相銜，結成一字橫陣，把正面封在河道稍寬之處；新羅的小型戰船在外側游弋，掩護唐軍側翼，同時封鎖水道，使倭國船隊無法繞到唐軍背後。倭國的船與人遠勝於唐羅聯軍，且分批抵達，理論上佔盡上風，但它三次攻擊唐軍橫陣都被擋回：唐軍以弩與砲在接舷之前消耗，日軍每逼近一寸，都要付出船隻與人力的代價。唐軍不急於反攻，而是以逸待勞，把主力與後續船隊留在後方，等日軍攻勢鬆懈、陣形散亂的時機才作總攻。日軍屢攻不下，戰意轉衰；唐軍這時以預備隊自兩翼包抄，把日軍戰船前後夾在河道中，船上士卒無處展開、難以回旋，接著趁風勢轉變以火攻焚燒其船隊，海面火勢蔓延，無法泅渡者大量被殺與被俘。白江口之戰後，新羅軍包圍周留城，切斷百濟復國勢力最後的據點；唐軍則守住白江口的水門，使任何後續救援都必須先通過這道封鎖。
tacticsEn: The outcome of the battle was decided by the shape of the river and by the discipline of the line. The Baek is the lower reach of the Geum, a narrow channel whose banks are mud flats and shallow banks; large ships can neither deploy nor pass one another there, while small craft can slip through and trouble the line. The Tang commander Liu Ren-gui lashed his ships bow to stern into a single transverse line, closing his front at the slightly wider part of the channel; Silla's small craft worked outside to cover the Tang flank and to seal the waterway, so that the Japanese fleet could not get round to the Tang rear. The Japanese had far more ships and men than the Tang and Silla combined, and their contingents arrived in successive waves, so on paper they held every advantage, yet three attacks on the Tang line were all turned back. The Tang met each assault with crossbows and stone-throwers before boarding, so that every inch the Japanese gained cost them hulls and men. The Tang did not hurry to counterattack; they waited, keeping the main body and the later contingents in the rear, and struck only when the Japanese attacks had slackened and their order had come apart. As the assault petered out, the Tang moved their reserves against both flanks, wedging the Japanese ships nose to tail in the channel where the crews had no room to fight and could not manoeuvre, and then, with the wind turning, set fire to the fleet. The flames spread over the water and those who could not swim were killed or taken. After the battle the Silla army surrounded Churyu, cutting off the last seat of the Paekche restoration movement, while the Tang held the mouth of the river, so that any relief had to pass that blockade first.
data: 可核對的數字集中在兵力、船舶與損失三方面，時間與地理也大致明確。時間：663年即唐龍朔三年八月，戰鬥歷時約兩日，記為農曆八月二十七至二十八日，合儒略曆十月四日至五日。唐軍：主將劉仁軌、杜爽，史料記「戰船百艘、糧船數百艘」，另有記載稱封鎖海口的唐軍為七千人、戰船一百七十艘。新羅：朴市田來札領兵五千、戰船百艘。倭國：阿部比羅夫於661年八月率五千人、一百七十艘船抵百濟，其後上毛野君稚子率二萬七千人、廬原君率一萬人陸續抵達，傳統說法合計出動四萬二千人，但各批次數字在《日本書紀》與後世史家的換算中分歧很大。損失：漢籍《新唐書·劉仁軌傳》記唐軍焚倭軍戰舟四百艘，《資治通鑑》記焚舟之時「火煙漲天，海水皆沸」，《日本書紀》則記戰船四艘、戰死與溺死者以萬計；兩系記載差距極大，只宜視為概數，不宜當作精確統計。地理：白江口在今忠清南道牙山市至公州市一帶的錦江下游，河道寬窄有限，兩岸多泥灘，大船受水深與潮汐限制；由此向上游不數十里即為百濟復國的都城周留。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster in three groups, men, ships and losses, and the time and the geography are reasonably clear. In time: the year was 663, the eighth month of Longshuo in the Tang calendar, and the fighting lasted about two days, recorded as the twenty-seventh and twenty-eighth days of the eighth lunar month, which correspond to the fourth and fifth of October in the Julian calendar. On the Tang side the commanders were Liu Ren-gui and Du Shuang, and the histories record a hundred warships and several hundred grain ships, while another record gives the force blockading the mouth of the river as seven thousand men and a hundred and seventy ships. On the Silla side Park Si-cheon-rae-chal led five thousand men and a hundred warships. On the Japanese side Abe no Hirafu reached Paekche in August 661 with five thousand men and a hundred and seventy ships, and were followed by Kamitsukeno no Kimi Wakako with twenty-seven thousand men and Iohara no Kimi with ten thousand; the traditional reckoning makes the total force dispatched forty-two thousand, but the figures for each contingent differ widely between the Nihon Shoki and later historians. On losses: the Tang history's biography of Liu Ren-gui records that four hundred Japanese ships were burned, the Comprehensive Mirror records that the fire made the smoke fill the sky and the sea water boil, while the Nihon Shoki gives four ships and more than ten thousand dead by battle and drowning. The gap between the two traditions is so wide that these should be taken as rough figures and not as precise counts. On geography: the mouth of the Baek lies on the lower Geum, in what is now the stretch between Asan and Gongju in Chungcheongnam-do, where the channel is not wide, the banks are mud flats, and large ships are limited by the depth of the water and by the tide; a few tens of li upstream stands Churyu, the capital of the Paekche restoration movement.
cause: 白江口之戰是三層原因疊加的結果。最底層是半島的權力格局：660年唐與新羅聯軍滅百濟，663年前後高句麗被壓到北方，四年之間半島的舊秩序被打散，百濟舊部、高句麗降人與新羅之間形成大量不滿與流亡人口，這批人成了復國運動的骨幹。第二層是日本與百濟之間的長期關係：百濟王室與倭國王室通婚數代，倭國一直視百濟為東亞最後一個可靠盟友，660年百濟覆亡、663年周留被圍，倭國朝廷在覽照皇后與中大兄皇子主導下決定出兵救援，以扶植扶餘隆重建百濟，作為對抗新羅、維持半島影響力的支點。第三層是唐與新羅各自的戰略需要：新羅必須消滅百濟復國勢力及其倭國靠山，才能獨佔百濟故地；唐則藉新羅出兵，一舉清剿百濟餘眾，同時試探能否把安東的經略由陸路推向海路，直接解決高句麗與百濟沿海的接應問題。導火線則是周留城被圍：扶餘隆向倭國求援，倭國船隊與後續援兵在八月下旬抵達白江口，而唐羅聯軍已在河口列陣等候，一場原本的解圍戰遂成為雙方決戰。
causeEn: The battle was the product of three layers of cause. The deepest was the distribution of power on the peninsula. In 660 the allied Tang and Silla armies destroyed Paekche, and by 663 Goguryeo was being pressed back to the north; within four years the old order of the peninsula had been broken up, and the former Paekche men, the surrendered Goguryeo people and Silla had produced a large population of the discontented and of refugees, and that population became the backbone of the restoration movement. The second layer was the long relationship between Japan and Paekche. The Paekche and Yamato royal houses had been linked by marriage for several generations, and Japan had always treated Paekche as its last dependable ally in East Asia. With Paekche destroyed in 660 and Churyu under siege in 663, the Japanese court, led by Empress Kōgyoku and Prince Naka no Ōe, decided to send troops to the relief, to set Buyeo Pung up again as king, and thereby to keep an anchor against Silla and a foothold on the peninsula. The third layer was the separate strategic need of the Tang and of Silla. Silla had to destroy the Paekche restoration movement and its Japanese support in order to hold the old Paekche lands alone; the Tang, for their part, would use Silla's intervention to clear out the Paekche remnants and at the same time test whether the administration of the eastern frontier could be pushed from the land route out to the sea route, so as to settle the problem of contact along the coasts of Goguryeo and Paekche. The spark was the siege of Churyu. Buyeo Pung called on Japan for help, the Japanese fleet and the later contingents reached the mouth of the river in the last third of the eighth month, and the Tang and Silla forces were already drawn up in the river mouth waiting; what had begun as an attempt to raise the siege turned into a decisive engagement between the two sides.
impact: 白江口之戰的影響有三層。第一層是戰略與制度層面的：它證明唐的水軍能夠在半島內陸河道上以編制與補給作戰；戰後唐廷把百濟故地交由新羅代管，663年後唐在半島的軍事存在幾乎清零，主導權轉到新羅手上，這是東亞國際格局的一次重新洗牌。第二層是日本層面的：白江口是倭國第一次在本土之外遭到決定性的失敗，日本朝廷據此檢討遠征政策，轉而推行律令、整頓畿內與開發本地資源，直到八世紀才重新以使節往來的方式接觸半島，直至十六世紀末豐臣秀吉兩度渡海征韓，才再以武力介入。第三層是歷史記憶層面的：白江口之戰在東亞被記為中日之間第一次大規模交鋒，1993年韓國在牙山白江口立碑紀念，日本學界多以「白村江」之名記載，雙方史書對同一場戰役的記載從戰船數字到死亡人數都互有出入，成為東亞史料互證與批判的典型案例。戰役本身的直接軍事影響其實有限，但它確定了往後數百年的東亞格局走向：唐羅聯盟很快轉為唐羅對立，直到668年滅高句麗，新羅才完成半島統一，而白江口式的遠征失敗，也從此成為東亞軍事史反覆引用的反面教材。
impactEn: The battle of Baekgang had three layers of consequence. The first was strategic and institutional: it showed that the Tang navy could fight on an inland river of the peninsula by means of formation and supply. After the victory the Tang court handed the old Paekche lands over to Silla to administer, and after 663 the Tang military presence on the peninsula was very nearly wiped out, with the initiative passing to Silla; that was a reordering of the East Asian balance. The second layer was Japanese. Baekgang was the first outright defeat Yamato suffered outside its own islands, and the court read the lesson off it, turning instead to the ritsuryō reforms, the tidying of the capital region and the development of local resources; Japan did not approach the peninsula again by mission and embassy until the eighth century, and did not resort to arms there again until Toyotomi Hideyoshi's two invasions of Korea at the end of the sixteenth century. The third layer was historical memory. The battle is recorded in East Asia as the first large-scale clash between China and Japan; a monument was raised at Baekgang-gu in Asan in 1993, and Japanese scholarship generally uses the name Hakusuki-no-e, while the Chinese, Korean and Japanese accounts differ from one another on everything from the number of ships to the number of dead, and the episode has become a classic case for the cross-checking and criticism of East Asian historical sources. The direct military effect of the battle was in fact limited, but it settled the direction of the East Asian order for the centuries to come: the Tang-Silla alliance soon turned into Tang-Silla rivalry, and only with the destruction of Goguryeo in 668 did Silla complete the unification of the peninsula; and the defeat of an expeditionary army at Baekgang has been cited ever since as a cautionary example in East Asian military history.
result: 白江口之戰以唐羅聯軍的全勝收場。戰役首日，倭國先鋒試圖強行通過白江口，被唐軍的橫陣與弩砲擋回；次日日軍援兵趕到，兵力數倍於唐羅聯軍，先後三次衝擊唐軍陣線都沒有突破，戰至午後隊形散亂；唐軍這時以預備隊自兩翼包抄，把日軍戰船擠塞在河道中無法展開，隨即以火攻焚燒其船隊，海上大量士卒被殺或被俘，殘兵退回本國。日軍損失的具體數字各書不一，最保守的說法是戰死與溺死者以萬計、戰船損失以百艘計。百濟一方，扶餘隆乘亂突圍退回周留城，新羅軍隨後完成對周留的包圍；復國政權在失去倭國之後再無外援，663至664年間被平定，扶餘隆率眾降唐，唐廷予以封爵並安置於內地。倭國則在慘敗之後放棄直接介入朝鮮半島，轉為純粹的使節往來，數百年間不再以兵戎介入。由此，663年的白江口既是百濟復國運動的終點，也是新羅統一半島的起點，更標誌著唐的東北亞政策由直接征服轉為以新羅代理、間接經營，而這一課後來反覆被東亞的出兵者引用。
resultEn: The battle of Baekgang ended in a complete victory for the Tang and Silla forces. On the first day the Japanese vanguard tried to force its way through the mouth of the river and was turned back by the Tang line and its crossbows and stone-throwers. On the second day the Japanese reinforcements arrived, several times the strength of the Tang and Silla force, and attacked the Tang line three times without breaking it, until in the afternoon their order came apart. The Tang then moved their reserves against both flanks, wedging the Japanese ships in the channel where they could not deploy, and set fire to the fleet; a great many of the men at sea were killed or taken, and the survivors withdrew to their own country. The exact Japanese losses differ from book to book; the most conservative account gives more than ten thousand dead by battle and drowning and the loss of ships in the hundreds. On the Paekche side, Buyeo Pung broke through and withdrew to Churyu, where the Silla army completed the investment of the city. Cut off from Japanese help, the restoration regime was put down between 663 and 664, and Buyeo Pung surrendered with his followers, receiving a title from the Tang court and settlement in the interior. Japan, after the disaster, gave up any direct intervention on the Korean peninsula and kept to missions alone, and did not resort to arms there again for several centuries. The battle of 663 was thus at once the end of the Paekche restoration movement, the beginning of Silla's unification of the peninsula, and the sign that the Tang had shifted from direct conquest in northeast Asia to indirect rule through a Silla that stood in for it, a lesson afterwards cited again and again by those who sent armies out across the sea.
